cases.head: 262bdf02288daf9a37b9e815b44acafd62b5c6fe
cases.label: Reading stdin by iteration in CliRunner aborts on normal end of input.

changes.input: Use CliRunner to invoke a command that iterates over a click.File('r') argument set to '-' with one line of stdin.
changes.before: The loop consumes the line and ends normally. The command exits with code 0.
changes.after: Normal iterator exhaustion raises EOFError. Click aborts and exits with code 1.
changes.evidence: https://github.com/pallets/click/issues/2939 and https://github.com/pallets/click/pull/2940; source in src/click/testing.py at the pinned revisions.
changes.support_reason: The change replaces an iteration protocol exception and propagates through the CLI runner.
